title: GETTING USED TO THE FAMILY OF GOD
stanzas: Going together, enjoying the trip, Getting used to the fam'ly I'll spend eternity with. Learning to love you, How easy it is, Getting used to the fam'ly of God.
Climbing the mountains, Crossing the plains, Fording the rivers, Sharing the pain. sometimes the losses And sometimes the gains, Getting used to the fam'ly of God
Reaching our hands To a brother that's new, Learning to say That I really love you, Learning to walk As the Father could do, Getting used to the fam'ly of God.
chorus: Going together, enjoying the trip, Getting used to the fam'ly I'll spend eternity with. Learning to love you, How easy it is, Getting used to the fam'ly of God.
